name: Go Idiomatic Reliability & Concurrency Hygiene
purpose: Enforce Go (1.22+) explicit error handling (%w/errors.Is/errors.As), context cancellation propagation, goroutine lifecycle ownership, -race detector verification, sync.Pool recycling, and table-driven tests.

inputs.name: source_files
inputs.description: Go source files and test suites (*.go)

outputs.name: hardened_code
outputs.description: Gofmt-compliant, race-free idiomatic Go source code

outputs.name: verification_report
outputs.description: Comprehensive Go verification report conforming to templates/go-verification-report.md

stop_conditions: Task acceptance criteria satisfied with evidence
go test -race ./... passes cleanly with zero data races
